problem.h2Part1: Most service businesses are held together by memory, WhatsApp, and
problem.block1Title: Reservations come in through six different channels.
problem.block1Body: Phone, Instagram DM, email, the website, walk-ins, and that one booking platform charging you 3% commission. Someone — usually you — keeps track in a notebook next to the register. Every missed booking is a missed evening.
problem.block2Title: Your customer data lives on someone else's server.
problem.block2Body: Names, phone numbers, visit history — all in platforms you don't own. You can't reach your own regulars directly. Every time they come back, you pay again.
problem.block3Body: The receptionist sends the confirmations. The practice assistant calls the no-shows. The waiter texts tonight's table to ask if they're still coming. Work a system should do, happening in people's heads.

header.subhead: Every OTS engagement starts with an Audit, evolves into a Build, and matures into a Retainer. You climb the ladder as it makes sense for your business — not before.

audit.title: The diagnosis.
audit.body: Two weeks. We map how your business actually works today — the workflows, the tools, the manual work. We deliver a written report with a systems roadmap. Even if you take nothing else from us afterwards, you're further along than where you started.
audit.photoAlt: Notebook and laptop on a warm-lit desk

build.title: The system.
build.body: Fixed price. Fixed scope. Four to twelve weeks. We build a working Business Operating System for one specific function in your business — reservations, patient intake, quote-to-invoice — including documentation and training.
build.photoAlt: Hands typing code on a laptop in a dimly lit workspace

retainer.title: The partner.
retainer.body: Monthly. We maintain and extend the systems we've built for you. Small improvements, monitoring, quarterly reviews, priority work. The long term.
retainer.photoAlt: Calendar and planner on a wooden desk

header.h2Part1: From first message to shipped system,

step1.title: Discovery — 45 minutes.
step1.body: A real conversation. We ask questions; you tell us how your business runs. At the end, we say honestly whether we're the right partner — or not.

step2.title: Audit — two weeks, €2,500.
step2.body: We map your operation. Interviews, workflows, tools. You get a written report with a concrete roadmap.

step3.title: Build — fixed price, fixed scope.
step3.body: We build the system. Weekly demos. Documentation written as we build, not after. Training for your team. Going live with confidence.

step4.title: Retainer — the long term.
step4.body: We keep the system running, and extend it as your business changes. Every Build is meant to become one.

header.subhead: Three industries we know intimately. Not four, not a dozen — three, and we go deep.

hospitality.title: Restaurants & hospitality.
hospitality.body: Reservations that don't get lost. Guests who don't cost commission. Reminders that send themselves. Everything that happens between "we have a table" and "come back again."

health.title: Clinics & practices.
health.body: Patient intake without paperwork. Reminders that halve the no-show rate. Follow-up that doesn't get forgotten. Systems that make care possible instead of administration.

professional.title: Accountants, advisors, firms.
professional.body: From quote to invoice, without a single manual step in between. Deliverables that arrive on time. Clients who renew themselves because the service repeats itself.

e1.title: Why we don't sell chatbots.
e1.excerpt: Every month another agency ships a chatbot. Every month the underlying operational chaos gets worse.
e1.photoAlt: Workspace with laptop and notebook in warm light

e2.title: Je reserveringen komen binnen via zes kanalen. Dat is het probleem, niet de drukte.
e2.excerpt: Most restaurants don't lose revenue from too few guests. They lose it because nobody knows exactly who's coming, when, and through which channel they said so. (Essay content is Dutch-only for now.)
e2.photoAlt: People collaborating at a table with laptops and notebooks

e3.title: What a two-week Audit actually looks like.
e3.excerpt: Interviews, workflows, and a 15-page report — inside the two weeks that precede every OTS Build.
e3.photoAlt: Notes and diagrams on a desk

pageHeader.h1: Three services. One progression. No hourly work.
pageHeader.subhead: OTS sells three engagements: an Audit, a Build, and a Retainer. Every client relationship follows this path. We don't sell hourly work. We don't sell one-off automations. We don't sell "chatbots." Below is what each one is, what it costs, and what you get.

audit.title: The diagnosis.
audit.whatItIs: A two-week diagnosis of how your business actually runs today. We map every workflow, every tool you use, every piece of manual work your team does. At the end, you get a written report with a concrete systems roadmap.
whatYouGet: A detailed workflow map of the audited function
A ranked list of friction points, with the cost to your business
One concrete "quick win" you can act on yourself tomorrow

timeline.label: Week 1
timeline.text: Kickoff call, interviews (2–4 stakeholders), workflow mapping

timeline.label: Week 2
timeline.text: Analysis, report drafting, internal review, delivery call

audit.whatYouDontGet: No implementation. No software. No recommendations without evidence. An Audit is a diagnosis — not a treatment. That's what the Build is for.

build.title: The system.
build.meta: fixed price · fixed scope · four to twelve weeks
build.whatItIs: A fixed-price, fixed-scope engagement of four to twelve weeks. We build a working Business Operating System for one specific function in your business — reservations, patient intake, quote-to-invoice — with documentation and training built in from day one, not added afterwards.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.description: full operating system for one function, 4–6 integrations

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.description: multi-function operating system, 6+ integrations, custom logic

sharedItems: full engineering, design and systems logic
30 days of stabilisation after delivery, included
build.whatYouDontGet: Third-party software licences — those you pay for directly. Maintenance after the 30-day stabilisation period — that's the Retainer. New functionality after scope is signed off, without a change order.

retainer.title: The partner.
retainer.whatItIs: A monthly partnership in which OTS maintains, monitors, and extends the systems we've built for you. Where most agencies stop at delivery, this is where the long term begins.

tiers.name: Monitor
tiers.description: monitoring, small fixes, monthly health report, one small extension per month

tiers.name: Operate
tiers.description: everything in Monitor, plus proactive improvements, two extension projects per month, quarterly review

tiers.name: Partner
tiers.description: everything in Operate, plus dedicated engineering time, roadmap planning, new systems within agreed scope

timeline.label: Ongoing
timeline.text: small improvements and priority work at your tier

retainer.whatYouDontGet: New, large systems outside scope without a separate Build agreement, unless you're on the Partner tier. No ad-hoc hours without a monthly agreement.

ladder.explainer: Every OTS client relationship follows this path. Roughly six in ten Audits become a Build. Roughly seven in ten Builds become a Retainer. The Retainer is where the real relationship lives — the long, quiet, compounding partnership. That's what we're working toward from the very first conversation.
